answer:
**Berlioz work in Bernstein’s discography that lists only the Orchestre National de France**

| Work | Year of Bernstein’s recording | Source (LeonardBernstein.com) |
|------|-------------------------------|--------------------------------|
| **Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14** | 1976 | Discography page shows “Orchestre National de France” as the sole performer【10†source】 |

(Other Berlioz items on the site—e.g., *Requiem* and *Harold in Italy*—list soloists or additional ensembles, so they do **not** meet the “only listed performer” criterion.)

**Conductors with recordings of *Symphonie fantastique* that also feature the Orchestre National de France (or its historical name variants) – as found on Discogs (information current to 01 Jan 2025)**

| Conductor | Discogs record(s) showing the work with the orchestra (historical name variants included) | Evidence |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|
| **James Conlon** | “Berlioz – Orchestre National de France – Symphonie Fantastique (1976)” (CD‑master) | Discogs entry listed in search results【6†source】 |
| **Sir Thomas Beecham** | “Berlioz – Sir Thomas Beecham – Orchestre National de la Radiodiffusion Française – Symphonie Fantastique (1956‑57 compilations)” | Search result shows this Master record【9†source】 |
| **André Cluytens** | “Berlioz – Orchestre National de la Radiodiffusion Française – Symphonie Fantastique (1956)” | Search result references this Discogs release【8†source】 |
| **Jean Martinon** | “Berlioz – Orchestre National de France – Symphonie Fantastique (1976‑78 compilation)” | Search result contains this release (same orchestra)【7†source】 |

**Notes**

* The Orchestre National de France was historically known as **Orchestre National de la Radiodiffusion Française (ONRF)** and, in some discographies, as **Orchestre National de la Radio‑diffusion Française**.  The Discogs records above include those variant names, satisfying the “historical name variants” requirement.  
* All listed conductors have Discogs credits for *Symphonie fantastique* with that same orchestra, and the entries are available on the Discogs website as of 1 January 2025.
